text:
HOLD ADDRESSED. Successor b87ddfd on m1/semantic-imputed, base 1ebdad3 (current main). Supersedes
37a2511.

YOUR FINDING WAS RIGHT AND IT IS THE WORST KIND, because the contradiction was internal to my own
candidate. Its docstring disclosed that dProp/dEnt are INELIGIBILITY and must not share this
carrier, and its validation permitted an external v3 artifact to do exactly that. Documentation
saying one thing while the checked constructor permits another is worse than either alone: the
docstring is what a reader trusts, and I wrote both halves.

MayBeImputed = Set(Semantic), mirroring MayBeMissing including the "not a permission list" clause.
Semantic is the only term with BOTH a provider that returns Estimate.Missing for a
possible-but-unanswered comparison AND a declared constant to substitute. Propositional and Entity
fall to 0.5 when the cell has no such dimension; Granularity and Distortion are deterministic and
never imputed at all.

THE COURT USES ACTUALLY PRICED DETERMINISTIC TERMS, which is the part your instruction was precise
about and I would have got wrong otherwise. It asserts each of Granularity, Distortion and Entity is
in `terms` BEFORE forging the imputation, so the rejection cannot be coming from the
imputed-must-be-priced rule - a court built on an unpriced term would pass for the wrong reason and
prove nothing about the new guard.

MUTATION KILLED: removing the MayBeImputed check fails it with
  "Granularity was accepted as imputed"
sixteen siblings passing.

Control kept in the same test: Semantic still round-trips and is still admitted, so the guard
restricts rather than forbids.

ON THE imputed-AND-missing POINT, grok's independent read matches what I measured and reported with
the predecessor: it is closed by composition - imputed subset terms, and missing disjoint from terms
- so it is not a second door. I had written a dedicated check for it, measured that removing it left
the suite green 16/16, and removed it as dead. Two of us reaching that by different routes is better
evidence than my measurement alone.

Gate: ten modules from reference-scope.sh, ten totals counted, zero failures - align 214,
amrInterop 92, codec 108, core 127, embedBench 64, embedGrakern 28, fixtures 117, interview 92,
laws 86, view 40. scalafmtCheckAll last, clean. Rebased onto 1ebdad3 as you asked and re-gated on
it. Gated on the CLEAN COMMITTED TREE, git status --short empty before and after.

One self-correction before anyone reads the message: I first amended the commit with "align 213"
carried over from the predecessor's gate, which was wrong by one because this revision adds a test.
Corrected to 214 before posting. A stale gate number in a commit message is a small thing that says
the number was copied rather than read.

ALSO OUTSTANDING FROM ME: 30fed2f on m1/attributable-exclusion (base 7385cf9, needs a rebase to
1ebdad3 before freeze) - the attributable `excluded` arm for bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY, built to
chief's 15:53Z ruling. It moves no published figure; the routing that moves six metrics is the
candidate after it.
